reviewed_by: Claude curator acting under owner authority
summary: Readings of the Building 001 sketch by ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok, with three disagreements deliberately left open: the handwritten leader (WARD. vs WTRD.), the canopy post count (three vs four or five), and one vs several proportional layouts.
rationale: The general lessons are already in the sketch-reconstruction proposal (refined in da00010): multi-observer disagreement is stored as ambiguous with provenance, cross-view correspondence, separation of interpretation from realization, multiple proportional realizations. They are not repeated as new rules. The case-specific value is the disagreement record itself, so it is attached to the new examples/building-001 and summarized there next to the v0.3 record, which shows only one reading of the leader (WTRD.) and one post count. v0.3 is kept verbatim rather than edited, so the example shows the gap. One observation is new and held: Gemini's prose answer made labeled assumptions sound authoritative, which suggests the evidence class must survive into natural-language output, not only into JSON and geometry. One case is not enough to propose a rule.
provenance: CUR-2026-10-27-BUILDING-001-SKETCH-REVIEW (Grok review of the same sketch)
